translations.web: In this love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
translations.bsb: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
translations.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
translations.asv: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
